latestFormalFinding.boundary: R113 records a PARTIAL_RETURN visibility pattern under the declared reversed memory-access intervention. The verified matched-parent control shows that, with task and intervention held constant, changing the formal parent changes provenance but not participant/silent selection under the formal v0.9 baseline. Therefore PARTIAL_RETURN is a descriptive return-pattern measurement, not evidence of visibility path dependence in the current deterministic formal rule.

latestExperimentalControl.boundary: Isolated counterfactual executor only. It deliberately includes parent round ordinal in participant selection and has been CI-verified against R111 and R112. It does not write or advance formal greenhouse history and is engineering evidence that NOSTROMO can execute and audit a parent-sensitive transition, not evidence that the real SHROOMING population is causally path-dependent.

latestThickening.boundary: Promotion is backed by successful NOSTROMO Integration Test run 227 for commit 970322634b1be0bb5beed6b8cd251472dad97d78 and vajra-conflict-escalation-test/v0.5.0 PASS. shrooming.boundary: Published-state inspection, sandbox reading, greenhouse question probing, and explicit formal greenhouse round advancement remain executable. In the verified active NOSTROMO loop, SHROOMING has a separate feedback-conditioned deterministic reader that reorders inspection lenses when explicit redacted upstream evidence or contradiction signals are present; this makes cross-organ feedback alter SHROOMING behavior rather than merely append text. The formal RUN_READING_ROUND baseline remains parent-invariant v0.9 and unchanged, preserving R111→R112→R113 reproducibility. Neither the feedback-conditioned active-loop reader nor the formal/experimental branches represent semantic learning or ten independently persistent live LLM processes.

muther.boundary: Published mining-state audit and repository corpus mining are executable. MINE_REPO collects repository candidates before bounded selection, fingerprints superficially normalized snippets, suppresses duplicate copies, records occurrence/provenance metadata and round-robins across path-derived source families to reduce first-file bias. This is deterministic structural diversity handling, not semantic clustering, source-quality scoring, novelty proof or truth judgment. Query-scoped Google Drive mining is executed by the authorized external connector runtime and handed back as redacted evidence. MINE_INTERNAL remains limited to explicit authorized query-scoped connector sources; it does not grant exhaustive private-environment crawling or cross-source enumeration. FALSIFY remains repository-scoped and absence is never upgraded to truth.

droplet.boundary: Published evidence audit and explicit-URL verification are executable. Search-engine discovery is executed by the external web connector runtime. VERIFY v1.1 computes SUPPORTED, REFUTED or INDETERMINATE over an explicit evidence bundle while suppressing exact replay amplification, counting caller-supplied source families as audit metadata, forcing INDETERMINATE on conflicting authoritative directions, and flagging contradictory use of one evidence fingerprint. It does not search the web by itself, prove source independence, score methodological quality, or treat absence of refutation as global truth.

gut.boundary: GUT v0.2.24 is a deterministic heuristic metabolic router. It preserves nutrient atoms, routes and provenance while applying bounded carry-rendering containment for inherited substrate, intra-atom and cross-segment echoes, volatile lineage, nested clauses, repeated route metadata and delimiter collisions. Machine-only hexadecimal ref/targetRef/clause/clauseRef identifiers are excluded from prose carry and preserved separately in a bounded carryRefs ledger with path, route, type and provenance, so referential continuity no longer depends on polluting semantic carry text. The verified VAJRA→GUT regression confirms targetRef continuity through carryRefs while the prose summary remains free of those machine tokens. These are deterministic structural normalization and routing rules, not semantic deletion, semantic novelty detection, semantic identity, source-truth judgment or proof that all metabolic echo is solved.

vajra.boundary: VAJRA v0.3.8 retains the proposition-aware core and verified uncertainty/provenance, contest-persistence and multi-organ conflict-context guards. Preserved contests generate DROPLET, MUTHER and SHROOMING adjudication packets with explicit scope and provenance contracts. Packet returns must match issued identity, returning organ, targetRef, clauseRef and substantive relation. Same-intake mutation replay is blocked with PACKET_ALREADY_RETURNED. The intake now also exposes acceptedPacketIds and can consume that ledger on later calls; a delayed or mutated return for a packet accepted earlier is quarantined as PACKET_PREVIOUSLY_RETURNED, preventing replay weight from accumulating across time when the ledger is persisted. Complete three-organ context can change VAJRA nextAction/nextQuestion while closureAuthority remains NONE and opposing evidence stays preserved. These remain deterministic lexical/structural heuristics and routing contracts, not semantic adjudication, source-quality weighting, factual truth, real-world source-independence proof or evidence that the original proposition is settled.
